subject: Spermidine Rescues Lipids and Reverses Metabolic Aging in Farmed Salmon
script: From Agewell Brief: Spermidine Rescues Lipids and Reverses Metabolic Aging in Farmed Salmon. Multiomic profiling reveals that farmed salmon accumulate cellular fats through conserved mammalian aging pathways, while dietary spermidine clears the blockage. Age-related metabolic decline in mammals stems from a breakdown in how tissues partition and burn energy. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
